independentFullOriginalReceipt.mapFootprintBlocker: Both longitude edges exceed the physical longitude domain by more than one half native cell; extreme cell centers exceed +/-180

products.maskConflict: Publisher machine JSON describes int8 and -200 NoData; original is actual Int16 with representable -200. Raw 0 (10,479 pixels) is not in the publisher legend and is not embedded NoData. No class or mask is invented.
products.extentHandling: The original 43,202-column grid has two outer longitude-column centres beyond +/-180. Default generic footprint guard rejects it. Parent-authorized integration must pin this exact original/source/hash before fitting the map display to physical WGS84 bounds; full TIFF bytes, full original extent, geotransform, column samples, values and mask remain unchanged. Arbitrary overflowing rasters are not accepted.
products.palette: No embedded TIFF color table. Preserve raw values; a grayscale preview is not the publisher categorical legend.
products.sourceRecipe: Direct public raster client recipe, exact epoch 2020 / version 2 / WGS84 30ss URL. Not publisher STAC. Request bounds are preserved; source query bounds are the explicitly disclosed physical intersection. Other year/month/region/season/country/layer parameters rejected.

products.title: The 30 m annual land cover datasets and its dynamics in China from 1985 to 2024
products.reason: The record publishes 74 annual mainland TIFF / provincial ZIP files. Bare mainland TIFF originals exceed 512 MiB. Province files are archive containers, not public standalone provincial TIFFs. No full raster was downloaded or decoded; no CRS/NoData is asserted as physically verified.

products.title: GLC_FCS30D: the first global 30-m land-cover dynamic monitoring product with fine classification system from 1985 to 2022
products.reason: Actual record has 36 geographic ZIP archives plus a PDF guide and LYR legend, no standalone GeoTIFF. The smallest W175-W180 full-container GET failed HTTP 504 before completing; no full download/decode/hash receipt was produced. CASEarth documents login-free FTP but current native HTTPS direct-raster workflow does not accept FTP or ZIP. This is a genuine candidate, not a ready connector.

products.citation: Potapov et al. (2022), The global 2000-2020 land cover and land use change dataset derived from the Landsat archive: first results. doi:10.3389/frsen.2022.856903.
products.science: Original GLCLUC v2 combined classified land cover/use at 0.00025-degree nominal resolution; distinct from existing Hansen forest-loss/tree-cover products. Published 2000,2005,2010,2015,2020 annual maps plus a separate 2000-2020 change layer. Correct per-code legend is required before production integration.
scienceWarnings: Legend 255 means No data, but the actual TIFF has no scalar NoData tag. The preset declaration is not silently imposed as the native file mask.

Code 0 is a valid annual-map desert / 3-percent short-vegetation class, not missing data. Code 254 is ocean, 244 cropland and 250 built-up; the full specific combined legend is required, not a continuous reflectance interpretation.

This original embeds a 256-entry palette. Raw indices, the actual palette and the unchanged map grid must be retained; do not replace class codes by RGB samples or imply statistical area validity from the map.

Initial full GET timed out only after 44,040,192 original bytes. A same-generation If-Match continuation supplied 454,847 remaining bytes. The entire 44,495,039-byte assembled original matches the publisher object API whole-file MD5 before all 1.6-billion original pixels were independently decoded. This is not Range-only/sample acceptance.
